captions.detailed: A realistic garage floor pump featuring a tall, red cylindrical barrel mounted on a wide, black foot base. A silver piston rod extends from the top of the barrel, capped with a black T-handle. On the side of the barrel, there is a black pressure gauge housing with a light gray face, a small black pressure-release button, and a black hose clip holding a simulated hose segment. The T-handle and piston rod slide vertically along the barrel axis, the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot, and the pressure-release button can be pressed inward.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a garage floor pump with a tall red barrel, a wide black foot base, and a silver piston rod topped with a black T-handle. Include a side-mounted black pressure gauge housing with a gray face, a small pressure-release button, and a side hose clip, ensuring joints are defined for the sliding handle, the rotating gauge needle, and the pushable release button.
captions.factory: The code constructs the pump by defining several parts. The base and main barrel are modeled using Cylinder and Box primitives combined with boolean operations to form the main pump body, styled in red and black. The piston rod and T-handle are modeled as a separate part using a thin silver Cylinder and a horizontal T-bar with black grips. The pressure gauge is built on the side using a circular disc for the face, a thin wedge for the needle, and a small cylinder for the release button. Prismatic joints are added for the piston rod (along the Z-axis) and the release button, while a revolute joint is defined for the gauge needle.
